notes.title: Mission Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]1.10.1 Update post[/h1]
Attention, Ninjas! With the 1.10.1 update, we bring to you heaps of juicy missions, an entirely new way of playing Fruit Ninja VR, and a whole rack of divine weapons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/1d8c3efea62c9ab3b34d830d614142dea88b1746.png[/img]

[h1]New Missions[/h1]
Explore our new and improved mission system, uncover all the secrets of Fruitasia, and discover new epic rewards. Make sure you conquer all the challenges to become a true Fruit Ninja Master! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/7010c76b6e1174694ae7e57244b4183a32fb0348.png[/img]

[h1]Any Weapon, Any Mode[/h1]
Ever played classic mode with a crossbow? No? Well now you can!
Weapons are no longer restricted to their original modes. Play around with all the weapons in any game mode to unsheath new possibilities of utilising your ol’ weapons! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/b5650a49e8d90208e2506d5e8425f3f4421deee7.png[/img]

[h1]New Gear[/h1]
Get ready to slice and dice in style! Our latest weapon update for Fruit Ninja in VR is here, bringing a dazzling array of cosmetic weapons to elevate your fruit-slicing experience to a whole new level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/2f756f9238da3391a5916f227a880b87ec90833a.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
Does the sky look a little different today? That’s right, the skybox just got an upgrade! Enjoy the new view of the Fruit Ninja world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/34f8937047f4055c974576561c3fa6c2005f620e.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a hand rotation issue with the bow
[*] Fixed issues with the leaderboard top 50 animation 
[*] Fixed visual issues with environment loading
[*] Fixed skeet shooting in the archery path
[*] Fixed golden fruits in the the archery path
[/list]

notes.title: First Post-Release Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Post-Release Update #1[/h1]
You'll find extended customization, fruit indicators, social features & more in our first post-release update!

[h2]Extended Customization Options[/h2]
We’ve expanded your customization options with brand new eye and skin customizations. Additionally, you can now see your chosen outfit and skin colour in single player!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/3b22a9eed307fab8efc94fe56c5c073dcbddb060.png[/img]
[h2]Offscreen Fruit Indicators[/h2]
Ported from Fruit Ninja 1 per popular request, this feature will point towards any fruit or bombs that are offscreen! These indicators can be changed to show all offscreen fruit or turned off completely from the settings menu.

[h2]Social Features[/h2]
We’ve expanded the social features in the social hub! You can now invite your friends to your lobby, start private lobbies and view your friends multiplayer status with Deep Presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/94a90920a27d77868a2e40ce4e1abf2b3ef11bd4.png[/img]
[h2]Chinese & Korean Language Support[/h2]
Chinese and Korean language support has been fully integrated and is accessible from the Language settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/dde788d936f2f6cd1d8d0dd742e0922fc1fde358.png[/img]
[h2]Tutorial Improvements[/h2]
A few sections of the tutorial have been reworked to improve clarity and reduce the chance of players losing direction.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Multiple bugs for multiplayer and singleplayer have been fixed.

[h2]Join our Community![/h2]
Connect with other Fruit Ninjas around the world, meet the developers, and provide your feedback on our Discord server!
https://discord.gg/fnvr2

notes.title: 2023 Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Now that Fruit Ninja VR 2 has been fully released, the team will be putting their all into consistent support for the game. We’re going to continue creating awesome content updates for all ninjas to enjoy. 

The team has put together a roadmap for the rest of 2023 to give you all a sneak peak on what to expect! Some things on the roadmap may be shifted around depending on player reception and our own internal processes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/6b13b78f458979038314932e32c30f2df283df3c.png[/img]

As you can see, we have a lot of exciting things planned for 2023. We'll will be putting a lot of focus on player freedom this year to allow ninjas to stab, slice and play however they like!

We’re delighted by the positive reception Fruit Ninja VR 2 has received following its full release. The team hopes our players will be just as delighted by the updates we release this year.

--The Fruit Ninja VR 2 Team

notes.title: Fruit Ninja VR 2 is leaving Early Access soon!
notes.notes:
With the upcoming 1.9.2 update and timed with our release on the Quest Store, we will be officially leaving Steam Early Access. Update 1.9.2 brings a massive list of performance improvements, bug fixes & support for Crossplay! 
 
[h2]Steam Price Increase 06/04/2023[/h2]
 
On 6th April 2023, we will be increasing the base price of Fruit Ninja VR 2 from $20 to $25 USD. This is an adjustment to bring the price in line with the Quest Store & reflect the game being out of Early Access.

[h2]Coming to the Quest Store![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that Fruit Ninja VR 2 is coming to the Quest Store on April 6th! We've been hard at work over the past few months to ensure that the game runs smoothly on Quest 2 and are confident that our efforts will make for an even better experience on all supported platforms, ensuring that you'll have the best possible experience with every slice.
 
[h2]What's next?[/h2]
 
Leaving Steam Early Access is a big milestone for us, but it's just the beginning! We have plenty of plans for new content and exciting Fruit Ninja action, including a new mode and weapon type that will be released after our launch on the Quest store and departure from Early Access. 

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
 
We have some exciting things to share with you all very soon and the team is incredibly grateful for your support throughout Early Access. Thank you for joining us on this journey, and we can't wait to see old and new ninjas jumping into Fruit Ninja VR 2. Get your ninja gear ready, it's time to slice some fruit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/f50434dd2b065c22e1509839d0f3180e584806dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Sensei, Gutsu & More!

notes.title: 🍏 New multiplayer game mode! 🏹
notes.notes:
[b][h2]APPLE HEAD[/h2][/b]
The first Multiplayer Mode is here! Head on over to the Social Hub and queue up for Apple Head, a 3-player PVP game mode where you must use your archery skills in a test of accuracy, reflexes and movement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/f8aa01b4d9cdeb4c410d0b62faa2ef945e59508f.gif[/img]

The longer you hold onto the apple, the more points you will score.
 
Block incoming arrows with shields, but when they break you have only your dodging skills to rely on.
 
If another Player steals the apple, whip out your bow and let loose a hail of arrows or practice eagle-eyed precision - whatever it takes to reclaim that apple!


[b][h2]THE ARENA[/h2][/b]
The Arena has finished its construction and its doors will open to all who dare to compete in the fast paced mayhem of Apple Head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/fd3309b7433a9a9a2631314f294759d7e87c20aa.gif[/img]

Brave the towering heights of the raised platforms and steel your resolve. It's time to show them who the fruit slicing champion is.


[b][h2]COMPETE AGAINST NINJAS FROM ALL OVER[/h2][/b]
With improved network performance, it's now easier than ever to play with friends from around the world. Pick your preferred region and then jump into a game of Apple Head together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/b16fc48733b80396eb9b267fd9c557d2318888c1.gif[/img]

notes.title: ☯ Zen Mode & Multiplayer Additions! 🕹
notes.notes:
Zen Mode has returned! The cave along the bamboo path has opened up, revealing a new area housing the fan favourite mode. Venture into the cave and experience its unique ambience, test your balancing skills with stackable stones, or just slice some fruit without the threat of those troublesome bombs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/bc16639586c60a64e0457743eea678c4c23ecd41.gif[/img]

Following the initial multiplayer launch, we’ve now added new features to our Social Hub. Multiplayer minigames continue with two new ways to play with friends: Fruit Basketball and Fruit Rain! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/c34be5013cc79b1226d4f544ef34a767611a8fa0.gif[/img]

Test your timing with Fruit Rain and shoot fruit hoops with your friends for high scores in Fruit Basketball!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/601675abc3ce523fde04c045eb8d241f620bd8b6.gif[/img]

Style your ninja with new Avatar colours and have the juiciest drip in all Fruitasia using the Ninja Scroll that is now fully functional in multiplayer!

notes.title: Smooth Locomotion!
notes.notes:
[h2]🏃‍️💨 Smooth Locomotion[/h2]
When we first released FNVR2, there were 2 options for travelling around the map in the game: blink teleport or dash. Through discussions with our players on our [url=https://discord.gg/FNVR2]Discord[/url], it was clear a more natural and immersive way to explore Fruitasia would improve the experience and that’s something we’ve been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/0bdc86d3cecac9eeb3d93302c41303d775f523bd.gif[/img]

In this latest update, you can now travel smoothly by pushing the analogue stick on your controllers in any direction. Need to jump to access some areas? Just press in the movement thumbstick and you’ll be able to aim and dash across gaps with no issue. You will also be able to choose between moving in the direction you are facing or moving in the direction your hand is pointing. If it's still not moving as you'd like, the movement and rotation speeds can also be customised in the Ninja Scroll settings tab!

We're always looking to improve the game with your feedback, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/FNVR2]Discord[/url]!
 
[h2]🎯 Archery Levels[/h2]
We have also added new content to the game in the form of 12 NEW Archery levels spread across 3 setlists. These levels are intended to introduce new players to the Archery mode and provide experienced players a chance to master the fundamentals 

More exciting updates coming soon, so keep an eye on this space!

HAPPY SLICING! 🍉

If you have any feedback or suggestions, be sure to hit us up in the Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/FNVR2]https://discord.gg/FNVR2[/url]

notes.title: 🤔 Classic Mode & 2022 Roadmap! ✨
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello Ninjas!
We got some good news, some really good news, and some bad news. Let’s have a look. [/b][/h3]

[h3][b]The bad news.[/b][/h3]
So as most of our players know our team has been working tirelessly on getting a build pushed out to Quest App Lab. However, as we are focussing on bringing it to Quest 2, we must make some changes.  

Our team had to make the decision to support Quest 2 only, due to ongoing performance concerns with Quest 1. Since supporting all generations of Quest is a requirement for App Lab, we had to make the hard decision to not release the game on App Lab for the time being. We still fully intend to release the game on Quest, and we will update the community as soon as our plans solidify. Stay tuned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/80dba94103454cdeb9997a487da6b1d6cb0ab7d2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Some good news. [/b][/h3]
As you have been asking for it, we are now implementing the fan-favorite Classic mode from Fruit Ninja VR! The team is currently hard at work bringing this original mode to life in Fruit Ninja VR 2, and you can expect it in our next update!  

In addition to Classic mode, we have also now begun work on the new Social Hub in preparation for our upcoming multiplayer modes. This endeavor will again take some time, so your patience is all we ask.  

To help our players get an understanding of what we have in production you can find below our roadmap. Hopefully, this will allow you to get a better understanding of where we are at and what we are planning.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/d155c3290ab9fe3a275128ad4631e9c3581e39ed.png[/img]
[i][NB: roadmap subject to change, depending on scheduling constraints and feedback received with each update][/i]

notes.title: 🎉 Early Access and Beyond! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  
 
With Fruit Ninja VR 2 going live we thought it would the perfect time to give everyone an update on what we have planned throughout early access and what people can look forward to.  

Before I begin, we would like to just take this time to say thank you. Thank you to all the members of the community that helped us out during development from playtesting to feedback.  

As we work our way through early access, we have a couple of things lined up.  
First and foremost.  
 
[h3]The Social Hub.[/h3]
A place that acts like a lobby. You will be able to join other players, chat and participate in minigames and interactions. This location will be the main hub for all things social.  

We have a couple of ideas for minigames and interactables but would LOVE your ideas and feedback on what people would enjoy. 

[h3]Multiplayer! Yes, it is coming. Soon.  [/h3]
You will be able to play full game modes with other players. You will be able to start multiplayer games from the social hub. Initially we will be building one mode but will be building up our catalogue the more that people play it.  

[h3]New Blades, Bows and Skins.  [/h3]
We plan to bring more regular updates with everything from new blades, bows, music tracks (rhythm mode), and collectable Sais. Over time we will be bringing in new levels and adjustments based on community feedback.  

Last but not least Bug fixes... but really that’s a given.  

Remember. If you want to find out more, ask the developers questions, and hangout with the team,  join our discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/fnvr2]https://discord.gg/fnvr2[/url]

notes.title: 📑 New menu interactions!

This all-in-one pad stays attached to your hand when brought up and interacts as you would expect to in real life. The tabs at the side allow you to switch between different menu options and keep an eye on your progress in the game wherever you are. You can even use the map here to teleport to the different areas (after walking there the first time to unlock it of course!).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/219d1c50b403efd03f51dca1b756071c29805c0d.png[/img]

We have also introduced a notification system and a glowing bracelet that can subtly remind you to check the Pad even while you are playing. No annoying pop-ups here! The jewel remains glowing until all your notifications are cleared so you don’t have to worry about forgetting something important. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778804/2f9ad86be27fbe35db3007d07b9b58ef074a63a6.png[/img]
